moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Kick Off
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading and Leeds Festivals begin this Thursday, August 27th, bringing a massive lineup including Florence + The Machine, Charli XCX, Dave, and Fontaines D.C. to rock the August Bank Holiday weekend.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds are GO! The August Bank Holiday weekend officially begins on Thursday as two of the UK's biggest festivals open their gates. Ready for the chaos?

angles.name: Lineup Hype
angles.copy: Florence + The Machine, Dave, Charli XCX, Fontaines D.C... the Reading & Leeds lineups are stacked! Who are you desperate to see this weekend?

moments.title: All Points East Continues in London
moments.blurb: London's All Points East festival continues its second weekend from Friday, August 28th to Sunday, August 30th, featuring headliners like Tyler, The Creator, Twenty One Pilots, and Deftones at Victoria Park.

angles.name: London Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Victoria Park is buzzing! All Points East kicks off its second weekend from Friday with Tyler, The Creator and more bringing the noise to London.

angles.name: Headliners Incoming
angles.copy: From Tyler, The Creator to Twenty One Pilots, All Points East has some HUGE names this weekend. Which set are you most hyped for?

moments.title: UK August Bank Holiday
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31, 2026, marking the unofficial end of summer for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Ahead
angles.copy: Who's ready for a long weekend? The August Bank Holiday is on Monday and it's the perfect excuse for one last summer hurrah! What are your plans?

angles.name: Local Plans
angles.copy: Three-day weekend incoming! The August Bank Holiday on Monday means extra time to explore our beautiful part of Wales. What local gems are you visiting?

moments.title: Premier League Action Continues
moments.blurb: The Premier League season continues this weekend with a packed schedule of matches from Friday, August 28th, through to the Bank Holiday Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Weekend Football
angles.copy: Football's back and firing! Premier League action ramps up this weekend, kicking off Friday. Who are you backing to grab the points?

angles.name: Big Game Buzz
angles.copy: Bank Holiday Monday football! Aston Villa vs Arsenal wraps up a huge Premier League weekend. Predictions for the big clash?

moments.title: Shirley Manson Turns 60
moments.blurb: Shirley Manson, the iconic Scottish lead singer of Garbage, celebrates her 60th birthday today, August 26, 2026. Born in 1966, she fronted the alternative rock band through massive success in the 90s and beyond.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Shirley
angles.copy: Happy 60th to the one and only Shirley Manson! The Garbage frontwoman has been an alt-rock icon for decades. What's your favourite Garbage track?

angles.name: 90s Icon
angles.copy: Push It! Stupid Girl! Shirley Manson turns 60 today, still rocking hard. Celebrating a true 90s legend.

moments.title: Florence Welch's 40th Birthday
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the captivating lead singer of Florence + The Machine, celebrates her 40th birthday on Friday, August 28, 2026. Born in 1986, she's known for her powerful vocals and unique indie-rock sound.

angles.name: Happy 40th Flo
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the incredible Florence Welch on Friday! From 'Dog Days Are Over' to 'Shake It Out', what's your top Florence + The Machine anthem?

angles.name: Indie Queen
angles.copy: Celebrating 40 years of the mesmerising Florence Welch! Her unique style and soaring vocals have defined an era. What do you love most about her music?

moments.title: Shania Twain Turns 61
moments.blurb: Canadian country-pop superstar Shania Twain, known as the 'Queen of Country Pop', celebrates her 61st birthday on Friday, August 28, 2026. Born in 1965, she has sold over 100 million records worldwide.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Shania
angles.copy: Man! We feel like celebrating! Happy 61st Birthday to the legendary Shania Twain on Friday. What's your favourite hit from the Queen of Country Pop?

angles.name: Country Pop Queen
angles.copy: Still the One! Shania Twain celebrates her 61st this week. Her music has soundtracked so many memories. What's your go-to Shania song?

moments.title: Liam Payne's 33rd Birthday
moments.blurb: Liam Payne, best known as a member of the global phenomenon One Direction, celebrates his 33rd birthday on Saturday, August 29, 2026. Born in 1993, he has also had a successful solo career.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: It's Liam Payne's 33rd Birthday on Saturday! From One Direction to his solo hits, what's your favourite track from Liam?

angles.name: 1D Memories
angles.copy: Throwback to the One Direction days as Liam Payne turns 33 this weekend! What's your most cherished 1D memory?

moments.title: Van Morrison Turns 81
moments.blurb: The legendary Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison celebrates his 81st birthday on Monday, August 31, 2026. Born in 1945, 'Van the Man' is known for his soulful blend of rock, R&B, and folk.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Van
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the iconic Van Morrison on Monday! From 'Brown Eyed Girl' to 'Moondance', what's your favourite track from Van the Man?

angles.name: Timeless Tunes
angles.copy: Still making music at 81! We're celebrating Van Morrison's birthday on Bank Holiday Monday. His songs are truly timeless. Which one holds a special place for you?

moments.title: Zendaya Turns 30
moments.blurb: Actress and singer Zendaya, a global style icon and star of 'Euphoria' and 'Dune', celebrates her 30th birthday on Monday, August 31, 2026. Born in 1996, she's achieved massive success across film, TV, and music.

angles.name: Happy 30th Zendaya
angles.copy: Happy 30th Birthday to the incredible Zendaya on Monday! From Disney star to Hollywood powerhouse, what's your favourite Zendaya moment?

angles.name: Style Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Zendaya's big 3-0 this Bank Holiday Monday! She truly does it all. What's your favourite of her many talents?

moments.title: Barry Gibb's 80th Birthday
moments.blurb: Sir Barry Gibb, the legendary co-founder of the Bee Gees, celebrates his 80th birthday on Tuesday, September 1, 2026. Born in 1946, he's one of the most successful songwriters in music history.

angles.name: Happy 80th Barry
angles.copy: Stayin' Alive and turning 80! Happy Birthday to the incredible Barry Gibb on Tuesday. What's your ultimate Bee Gees track?

angles.name: Disco Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating 80 years of the incomparable Barry Gibb! A true music legend who shaped the sound of generations. What's your favourite Bee Gees era?

moments.title: Gloria Estefan Turns 69
moments.blurb: Cuban-American singer Gloria Estefan, known as the 'Queen of Latin Pop' and for her work with Miami Sound Machine, celebrates her 69th birthday on Tuesday, September 1, 2026. Born in 1957, she's a five-time Grammy winner.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gloria

angles.name: Latin Pop Queen
angles.copy: The Rhythm Is Gonna Get You! Celebrating Gloria Estefan's 69th Birthday. Her incredible voice and infectious beats have graced the charts for decades.

moments.title: Beyoncé's 45th Birthday
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé, the 'Queen Bey', celebrates her 45th birthday on Friday, September 4, 2026. Born in 1981, she's one of the best-selling music artists of all time, known for her groundbreaking albums and electrifying performances.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Queen Bey
angles.copy: Who runs the world? Beyoncé! Happy 45th Birthday to the one and only Queen Bey on Friday. What's your all-time favourite Beyoncé track?

angles.name: Iconic Influence
angles.copy: Celebrating 45 years of Beyoncé! Her impact on music, fashion, and culture is undeniable. What's the most iconic Beyoncé moment for you?
